claims: U.S. citizens must have a valid passport for travel to Europe in 2026.
U.S. citizens must obtain an ETIAS authorization for Schengen Area countries starting in late 2026.
Passports must be valid for at least three months beyond the planned departure date.
The European Travel Information and Authorisation System (ETIAS) is expected to launch in late 2026.
ETIAS requires pre-registration for visa-exempt travelers.
As of late 2025/2026, the Entry/Exit System (EES) will replace manual passport stamps with automated, biometric e-gates.
The UK has its own currency.
